plugins.Author: DhogGPT
plugins.Name: Deep Ducking
plugins.Punchline: Deep Ducking public host and authenticated module access.
plugins.Description:
The Deep Ducking public host provides the introduction, community links and authenticated loading of separately supplied DDuck modules. /deepducking and /dduck open the introduction when no module is loaded.

Full module required for all commands below except opening the host window.

Commands (use /deepducking; /dduck is an alias):
/deepducking [toggle main window]
/dduck [alias for /deepducking; accepts all commands below]
/deepducking mini [toggle Mini]
/deepducking settings [open Settings]
/deepducking config [open Settings]
/deepducking debug [reveal and open Advanced for this plugin load]
/deepducking help [open command help]
/deepducking start [floor] [start or continue selected save; optional fresh-run floor]
/deepducking party-start [floor] [alias for start]
/deepducking party [select fixed-party POTD while idle]
/deepducking adopt [bind eligible already-entered party dungeon]
/deepducking hold [pause local output; retain run for Resume]
/deepducking resume [resume retained local run after readiness checks]
/deepducking nextstop [exit after next boss]
/deepducking ns [exit after next boss]
/deepducking stop [FULL STOP; persist local lock across reloads; stay in duty]
/deepducking reset-stop [clear eligible FULL STOP after cleanup; do not start]
/deepducking status [print local status]
/deepducking inspect [record read-only client and native observations]
/deepducking saves [open Saves]
/deepducking saves info <dungeon> [inspect native saves]
/deepducking saves delete <dungeon> <1|2> [delete selected save after native checks; no extra confirmation]
/deepducking saves dof <dungeon> <1|2> <on|off> [set future-failure deletion preference; no deletion now]
/deepducking saves cancel [cancel pending save or Start preparation; completed actions remain]

Dungeon arguments: potd, hoh, eo, pt. [floor] is optional; <...> is required. Choose one value for 1|2 or on|off; omit brackets when typing. Start can replace stopped state; Resume can release an eligible retained in-dungeon run. nextstop and ns retain the save and keep Mini open until return is observed; repeat to confirm the same request. Use the existing boss-break button to cancel.

If DailyDuty is installed, /dd is unavailable for Deep Ducking; use /deepducking. An alias owned by another plugin is preserved.
plugins.Changelog: - Updated the public host version.

plugins.Description: Takes the A Realm Reborn relic of the job you pick up to the stage you pick, from one Start button: the stage quests, the Atma FATEs, the Trials of the Braves books, Sphere Scroll infusion, the Light and Mahatma farms, the Zodiac Braves quests, Jalzahn's upgrades and, optionally, Kettle to the Mettle. DAD with FrenRider can run the dungeons instead of AutoDuty; Lifestream is needed for market board purchases. The Settings tab lists every plugin with a button that copies its repository link.
plugins.TestingChangelog:
0.9.0, first stable release since 0.1.0. ZodiacHelper now takes the A Realm Reborn relic of your job from A Relic Reborn to Zeta, and optionally through Kettle to the Mettle, from one Start button on the Main tab.
- Autopilot: picks the next step for the job you choose and runs it. It stops with the reason when a step fails twice. Tested in game on two relics of one character, both up to Zeta.
- Stage quests run through WigglyQuest with paths bundled in the plugin: A Relic Reborn, Up in Arms, Gerolt's furnace for the Zenith, His Dark Materia and the rest.
- Atma farm flies to the FATEs, syncs and fights. It skips FATEs with 2 minutes or less left.
- Trials of the Braves books: enemies, FATEs, dungeons and leves, including capture, escort and lure leves, and it unlocks the levemetes first.
- Novus: gets the sphere scroll, buys the materia from Universalis prices across your region, and infuses.
- Light and Mahatma farms through AutoDuty, Poetics through Duty Support, Alexandrite through LootGoblin maps or Allied Seals in lots of 5.
- Zodiac: the four material quests, including the HQ items they ask for at their last step, then Jalzahn's recreation and the Zeta awakening.
- Market board purchases through Lifestream on any world of your region, when "Buy from market board" is on.
- Combat plugin setting: Auto, Rotation Solver, BossMod or Wrath Combo. It applies to ZodiacHelper's own fights, AutoDuty and DAD duties, and LootGoblin's map fights.
- Gear is repaired between targets, and anything that attacks you during a non-combat step is fought back.
- Settings tab: every plugin it uses with its state and a button that copies its repository link, then the dungeon runner, combat plugin, maps, market board and repair settings. The stage tabs are inside a Manual tab, for doing each stage by hand.
Not tried in game yet: progress sharing between clients (Party tab), and DAD duties with Wrath Combo or BossMod as the combat plugin.
